name: petali-aivevia
description: Petali - gioco mobile Android e iOS con Capacitor

scripts.android:init: npm run build:bridge && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios:init: npm run build:bridge && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:bridge && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:bridge && npx cap sync ios
